name: Mississippi
intro: Official local contacts for winter storms, outages, and extreme temperatures in central Mississippi and on the Mississippi Gulf Coast. Every office, shelter source, and outage map below is from a county or city government, the Mississippi Emergency Management Agency, the Mississippi Public Service Commission, an electric utility or cooperative, or the American Red Cross. Shelter and warming or cooling center locations are opened as needed — always check the official sources, not a static list.
